question:
In the following question, out of the given four alternatives, select the alternative which best expresses the meaning of the Idiom Phrase.

As easy as pie
solution:
The correct answer is "**Very easy.**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The idiom phrase "as easy as pie" means that something is very easy to do.**(बहुत आसान)
 
• This phrase is often used to describe tasks or activities that are simple and require little effort.
 
• Other similar idioms include "a piece of cake" and "child's play," which also imply that something is very easy to do.
 
 
• Example: Using the computer was as easy as pie.
 
 

Hence, **the correct answer is option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 1, "Tasteful" means attractive and well chosen.(सुस्वादु)
 
• Option 2, "Auspicious" means something that seems likely to be successful in the future.(शुभ)
 
• Option 4, "Difficult choice" a decision that is hard to make.(मुश्किल विकल्प)
